scope: Tiny synthetic standalone workerd capability check only. Heap snapshot is intrusive, may collect garbage, and is not a normal peak/timing measurement. Raw snapshot may contain runtime strings/code; no real fixture, secrets, bindings or network source used.
gc_interpretation: Before/control/after expose observed heap change only. No explicit collectGarbage command was issued; concurrent natural GC and snapshot-induced GC cannot be separated without supported GC events. Snapshot data describes its own intrusive collection, not the pre-snapshot high-water heap.
